summary: P0 Account deletion + 30-day restore + admin tools validated. Backend pytest suite (10 tests, 100% pass) covers self-delete, system-account guard, admin-delete via lifecycle, admin username/email change (200/409/400/403/401 matrix), username reservation during pending deletion, and audit log writes. Frontend e2e validates delete modal copy + DELETE gate, stealth Admin tab (header/dashboard-link/password-reset/user-search/identity-button), tfone has no Admin tab, self-delete → re-login → RestoreAccountPrompt with both buttons. All required data-testid hooks present. App route shell correctly replaced by RestoreAccountPrompt on /feed after pending-delete re-login.
action_items: OPTIONAL — manually re-confirm RestoreGate blocks all routes (not just /feed). The Playwright run navigated to /home while in pending-deletion state and the restore-account-page selector was not found in that single attempt; however the same selector was found on /feed in the same session and the routing flow is wrapped via RestoreGate per code review. Likely a race in the test, but a quick spot check by the main agent is worth doing.
critical_code_review_comments: account_lifecycle.py is clean and well-documented (~200 lines). 30-day RESTORE_WINDOW_DAYS centralized, audit_log writes wrapped in try/except so they never block lifecycle.

admin_user_control.py uses re-import inside delete_user (`from core.account_lifecycle import mark_admin_delete`) — consider hoisting the import to module level for consistency with mark_restore which is also imported inside the function.
profile.py self-delete endpoint protects by username allowlist {stealth, support} + is_protected flag. Defense-in-depth matches spec.
Public profile lookup correctly delegates to should_hide_from_public(); returns generic 'Profile not found' (avoids leaking deletion state).
Suggestion: add an integration test or cron stub that uses is_purge_due() — currently no executor exists, only a helper.
seed_data_creation: Test creates throwaway users via /api/auth/register with prefixes qe2*, rsv*, oth*, aud* — these remain in DB in soft-deleted or active state; not cleaned up. Recommend periodic test-user purge job.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_account_lifecycle.py. Run with `pytest tests/test_account_lifecycle.py -v`. Test users tfone & tftwo are auto-restored at the start AND end of the module via the ensure_test_users_active fixture, so suite is rerunnable. Frontend selectors verified: account-delete-section, account-delete-open, delete-account-modal, delete-account-warning (contains all 6 mandated phrases), delete-account-confirm, delete-account-confirm-input, account-tab-admin (stealth only), tab-admin, admin-tab-header, admin-tab-dashboard-link, admin-password-reset-widget, admin-user-search-input, admin-user-row-<id>, admin-user-identity-btn-<id>, restore-account-page, restore-account-restore, restore-account-continue. Confirmed: confirm button is disabled before typing 'DELETE' and becomes enabled after. Esc key closes the modal.
